name: MagicMouse
author: 2strange
description: Apple Magic Mouse that feels like on a Mac, about 98%: touchpad-style scrolling with glide, live workspace swipe, Apple's pointer curve, edge and palm rejection, several mice, battery in the bar and in Bluetooth. Since 1.4 touch is clean: the mouse reports hover versus touch itself, a byte the hid_magicmouse driver drops unless install.sh turns on its report_undeciphered option. 2.0 is rewritten in Rust: one small binary, about 1% CPU while scrolling on a Late 2013 MacBook Pro (1.x: about 5%).

barWidget.description: Mouse battery and name in the bar; click for pointer, scroll, gesture and touch settings
